sentences.text: Scientists estimate this giant dinosaur reached a length of 18 meters and weighed 14.4 tonnes.
Researchers suspect it possessed armor, although its full appearance remains unknown without more fossils.
Adamantisaurus is classified within the family Saltasauridae.
It also belongs to the tribe Aeolosaurini.
All titanosaurs at least as derived as Malawisaurus, including Adamantisaurus, are members of the clade Lithostrotia.
This animal lived during the Late Cretaceous Period, specifically between the Turonian and early Maastrichtian stages.
It inhabited the region now known as South America around 75 million years ago during the Campanian stage.
Because Adamantisaurus is incompletely known, its exact phylogenetic relationships are difficult to establish.
